scriptData.code:
-- TinyStudio Lunar Lander Flight & Touchdown Controller
print("Lunar Lander Initialized!")

local lander = getEntityByName("CSG Result")
local StatusUI = getEntityByName("UIText 4")

-- Flight Settings
local THRUST_POWER = 500      -- Main rocket thrust power (Space)
local TILT_SPEED = 2.0         -- Tilt speed in rad/sec (WASD)
local MAX_TILT = math.rad(45)  -- Max tilt angle (45 degrees)
local MAX_SAFE_SPEED = 1.0     -- Max vertical impact speed for safe landing

local hasTouched = false
local landed = false
local crashed = false
local lastY = Transform.position.y
local impactSpeed = 0

-- 1. Contact / Touchdown Listener on Player's Physics
Physics:on("touched", function(other)
    if not hasTouched and not landed and not crashed then
        hasTouched = true
        print(string.format("Touchdown contact! V-Speed: %.2f", impactSpeed))
    end
end)

while true do
    local dt = 0.02

    -- 2. Sync the cosmetic visual costume to the player hitbox
    if lander and lander.Transform then
        lander.Transform.position = Transform.position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        lander.Transform.rotation = Transform.rotation
    end

    -- 3. Calculate vertical descent speed
    local currentY = Transform.position.y
    local vSpeed = math.abs((currentY - lastY) / dt)
    impactSpeed = vSpeed
    lastY = currentY

    UI.setText("UIText 3", string.format("ALT: %.1f m", currentY))
    UI.setText("UIText 5", string.format("V-SPD: %.1f m/s", math.abs(vSpeed)))

    if not landed and not crashed then
        -- 4. WASD Attitude / Tilt Controls
        -- W/S = Pitch (tilt forward / back)
        if Input.isKeyDown("KeyW") or Input.isKeyDown("ArrowUp") then
            Transform.rotation.x = math.min(MAX_TILT, Transform.rotation.x + TILT_SPEED * dt)
        elseif Input.isKeyDown("KeyS") or Input.isKeyDown("ArrowDown") then
            Transform.rotation.x = math.max(-MAX_TILT, Transform.rotation.x - TILT_SPEED * dt)
        end

        -- 5. Space: Main Thruster (pushes along the craft's tilted up-axis)
        if Input.isKeyDown("Space") then
            local up = Transform.rotation:getUpVector()
            local thrust = up * THRUST_POWER
            Physics:applyImpulse(thrust.x, thrust.y, -thrust.z)
        end

        -- 6. Touchdown Settlement & Stability Check
        if hasTouched then
            -- Wait a few frames for physics to stabilize on the ground
            wait(0.35)

            -- Evaluate speed at contact
            if impactSpeed > MAX_SAFE_SPEED then
                crashed = true
                UI.setText("UIText 4", "Crashed! Too fast.")
                UI.setVisible("UIText 4", true)
            else
                -- Check if upright: UpVector.y will be close to 1.0 if standing on landing gear
                local finalUp = Transform.rotation:getUpVector()
                if finalUp.y >= 0.75 then
                    landed = true
                    UI.setText("UIText 4", "Landed!")
                    UI.setVisible("UIText 4", true)
                else
                    crashed = true
                    UI.setText("UIText 4", "Crashed! Didn't land.")
                    UI.setVisible("UIText 4", true)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    wait(dt)
end
